title: koeleria macrantha f. longifolia
intro: Koeleria macrantha f. longifolia, commonly known as tall hair grass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is primarily found in the mountainous regions of Asia and Europe. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Koeleria macrantha f. longifolia include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
